judgements.reason: CharacterTheory is almost entirely built in Tau Ceti (table, Burnside, Frobenius-Schur realizability, Frobenius's theorem, sound Dixon solver), leaving Brauer's induction/splitting-field theorem and the cuspidal GL_2(F_q) table; Habiro must build its whole completion theory from nothing: the inverse-limit ring and topology, expansions and algorithms, Taylor maps with p-adic re-expansion, Habiro's rigidity theorems and module completions.

Habiro is one six-stage chain of cyclotomic-completion commutative algebra from a single paper; Ado-Iwasawa needs the missing independence half of PBW with domain/Noetherian corollaries, nilradical and derivation-lifting theory, extensions across split ideals, Levi decomposition, Hochschild's strengthening and Iwasawa's central p-polynomial/Krull argument - somewhat more theory stacked deeper, though both are import-free algebra.

Ado-Iwasawa is a bounded Lie-algebra project (PBW independence, Levi, Hochschild strengthening, central p-polynomials); ModularForms, though its Hecke/newform trunk is built, still needs modular symbols with Eichler-Shimura and coefficient fields, Galois stability, bad-prime newform theory, analytic Riemann-Roch over the unbuilt Fuchsian compactification for dimension formulas, and the Eichler-Selberg trace formula.

ModularForms' remaining modular-symbol, Riemann-Roch and trace-formula work sits on a largely built classical trunk; ArithmeticGaloisDuality needs Hochschild-Serre, G_{F,S} finiteness, Tate's Euler characteristic and Poitou-Tate over the unbuilt class field theory roadmap (reciprocity, local Tate duality), and its Selmer layers import period rings, Bloch-Kato maps, perfectoid tilting and infinity-categorical derived sheaves.

AlgebraicModuli's own content is huge (Hilbert/Quot schemes, algebraic spaces and stacks, Artin representability, characteristic-0 resolution of singularities) with only formal/rigid-geometry imports; ArithmeticGaloisDuality adds to its Poitou-Tate and derived-duality core all of class field theory and, through its Selmer layers, p-adic Hodge period rings, perfectoid tilting and infinity-categorical enhancements, which I judge slightly more and deeper.

FiniteFields' Weil/Deligne bounds import the Weil conjectures and Deligne's Weil I-II purity with Lefschetz pencils, etale duality and the trace formula, and via abelian schemes AlgebraicModuli's own R09.1-R09.4 and A0 layers; what AlgebraicModuli has beyond that overlap (coarse spaces, algebraization, resolution of singularities, formal/rigid GAGA) is clearly smaller.

Zigzag's missing theory is Koszul, Calabi-Yau and A-infinity homological algebra (its layers 5-8 plus the untouched DGAInfinity layers); FiniteFields' bounds need the whole l-adic machinery through Weil II with Lefschetz pencils, etale duality, abelian-scheme and moduli foundations, far larger and deeper.

Zigzag needs DG/A-infinity foundations, Koszul duality, Keller's CY-completion identification, Liu-Wang formality and braid actions; InverseGalois needs etale fundamental groups with specialization, Hilbert irreducibility, Riemann existence via imported GAGA and etale cohomology, Shafarevich's theorem and Hurwitz spaces over imported Hilbert schemes, algebraic spaces and stacks - clearly more foundation stacked higher.

OptimalTransport lacks a vast body of analysis beyond its built layers 0-4 (Brenier and Caffarelli/MTW regularity, McCann on manifolds, AGS gradient flows and JKO, entropic transport, RCD theory, Gromov-Wasserstein) but sits on rich measure-theoretic foundations; InverseGalois' Riemann existence, specialization, Shafarevich and Hurwitz-space targets require whole absent foundations (etale cohomology and Jacobians, coherent analytic sheaves and GAGA, Hilbert schemes, algebraic spaces and stacks), which tips it slightly.

OptimalTransport's remaining theory is broad but self-contained analysis over strong foundations; Motives needs Chow, Voevodsky and Nori motives with Tannakian reconstruction on top of imported Fulton intersection theory with GRR, etale cohomology and comparison theorems, higher Chow groups and transfers, and through them Thomason-Trobaugh scheme K-theory with Quillen/Waldhausen K-theory and spectra.

Motives' higher-Chow import (MotivicEtaleKTheory M.4) requires SchemeKTheoryOperations S.1-S.6 itself, and Motives adds intersection theory with GRR, etale cohomology and comparisons, motivic homotopy with transfers, DM_gm, Nori motives and Tannakian reconstruction; SchemeKTheory needs only its Thomason-Trobaugh layers, operations and GRR over the K-theory and spectra foundations.

SchemeKTheory needs Thomason-Trobaugh theory, lambda-operations and GRR over Quillen/Waldhausen K-theory and spectra; FarguesFontaineDiamonds' short own chain sits on the unbuilt adic FF curve, perfectoid spaces with almost purity, diamonds and v-descent, Huber's adic etale geometry, prismatic quotients, full infinity-categorical enhancements and, for F5, diamond etale cohomology with six operations over classical etale cohomology.

PadicHodgeRegulators' signed and de Rham regulator layer imports FarguesFontaineDiamonds F0-F3 with its perfectoid/diamond stack and much more (automorphic Galois representations, Shimura varieties, Deligne purity), and its K_3 theorem separately imports motivic cohomology, scheme and local-field K-theory and Poitou-Tate; FarguesFontaineDiamonds needs only the diamond and etale-cohomology part of that.

CharacterTheory lacks only Brauer's induction/splitting-field theorem and the cuspidal GL_2(F_q) table on a nearly complete Tau Ceti base; ModularForms still needs modular symbols with Eichler-Shimura, Galois stability, bad-prime newform theory, analytic Riemann-Roch over the Fuchsian compactification, and the trace formula.

PadicHodgeRegulators' etale/syntomic regulators and K_3 theorem import SchemeKTheoryOperations S.1-S.6 with all its K-theory foundations, plus motivic cohomology, Suslin's Bloch-group sequence, K-theory of local fields, p-adic Hodge and (phi,Gamma)-module theory and Iwasawa cohomology; SchemeKTheory's missing theory is a proper part of that.

Both rest on the same imported classical etale cohomology, etale duality and abelian-scheme/moduli layers; beyond them FiniteFields adds Weil I-II with Lefschetz pencils and monodromy, while FarguesFontaineDiamonds adds the adic FF curve, perfectoid spaces and almost purity, diamonds, Huber's adic etale theory, prismatic quotients, diamond etale cohomology and six operations - a somewhat larger and taller stack.

CharacterTheory has only Brauer's induction theorem, the splitting field and the cuspidal GL_2(F_q) table left on a built base; Ado-Iwasawa must build PBW independence, nilradical and derivation-lifting theory, split-extension representations, Levi decomposition, Hochschild's strengthening and the central p-polynomial/Krull argument from scratch.

InverseGalois needs etale fundamental groups, GAGA-based Riemann existence, Shafarevich and Hurwitz spaces over imported etale cohomology, analytic geometry and stacks; PadicHodgeRegulators imports higher and motivic K-theory, p-adic Hodge and (phi,Gamma) theory, Iwasawa cohomology and Poitou-Tate, and through automorphic Galois representations Shimura varieties, Deligne purity and the diamond machinery, which already contain InverseGalois' moduli (R09.1-R09.4) and GAGA (C0-C4) imports and etale cohomology.

Habiro is a self-contained six-stage commutative-algebra development (cyclotomic completion, expansions, Taylor maps, rigidity theorems); ArithmeticGaloisDuality needs Poitou-Tate and Tate's Euler characteristic over unbuilt class field theory, plus period rings, Bloch-Kato maps and perfectoid/infinity-categorical imports for its Selmer layers.

Zigzag needs Koszul and Ginzburg/CY-completion results, Liu-Wang formality and braid actions over the untouched DGAInfinity layers (DG/A-infinity categories, minimal models, bar-cobar, derived Morita, Hochschild deformation theory, Koszul duality); OptimalTransport needs twelve unbuilt layers of major analysis (Brenier and Monge-Ampere regularity, Riemannian transport with missing exponential-map input, gradient flows and JKO, entropic transport, RCD theory, Gromov-Wasserstein), clearly more in total.

AlgebraicModuli builds Hilbert schemes, algebraic spaces and stacks, Artin representability and resolution of singularities; Motives imports comparable stack, deformation and alteration foundations (SchemeAndStackFoundations SF.1, SF.4) and in addition etale cohomology and comparison theorems, Fulton intersection theory with GRR, higher K-theory through Thomason-Trobaugh, higher Chow groups and motivic homotopy, before building Chow, Voevodsky and Nori motives.

Habiro is a single self-contained completion theory; ModularForms still needs modular symbols with Eichler-Shimura and coefficient fields, Galois stability and LMFDB invariants, bad-prime newform theory, the Fuchsian compactification with analytic Riemann-Roch for dimension formulas, and the Eichler-Selberg trace formula.

Ado-Iwasawa is a bounded Lie-algebra project (PBW independence, Levi, Hochschild strengthening, central p-polynomials); FiniteFields' Weil/Deligne bounds import etale cohomology with the trace formula, duality, Lefschetz pencils and Deligne's Weil I-II purity together with abelian-scheme and moduli foundations.

Zigzag's missing theory is Koszul/CY/A-infinity homological algebra with its DGAInfinity import; FarguesFontaineDiamonds needs the unbuilt adic FF curve plus perfectoid spaces, diamonds and v-descent, adic etale geometry, prismatic quotients, full infinity-categorical enhancements and diamond etale cohomology over classical etale cohomology - far more and deeper.
